name: Chess Trainer
description: Personal chess trainer: Lichess games, Stockfish analysis, LLM coaching, drills and repertoire.

STOCKFISH_PATH.description: Path to the Stockfish binary from the Aptfile package.

STOCKFISH_HASH_MB.description: Stockfish hash size in MB (free dyno has 512MB RAM).

STOCKFISH_TIME_MS.description: Stockfish time limit per position in ms.

LLM_API_KEY.description: LLM API key (OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible provider). Fill in after deploy.

LLM_BASE_URL.description: LLM base URL. Fill in after deploy.

LLM_MODEL.description: LLM model name. Fill in after deploy.
